method: Manual inspection of exact georeferenced 40 m ground crops centred on individual automatic candidate positions, plus full registered atlas context. Selection regions only choose review candidates; exclusions are explicit raw candidate IDs. RGB yellow selection only selects controls, never automatically rejects. Every promoted negative crop was inspected; uncertain vegetation, all actual crowns and all OSM tree records remain. No performance thinning.
rawRetention: Every excluded raw candidate remains below, with its original index, coordinate and crown radius. Original input hash and mosaic hash retain provenance. The active trees array removes only these explicitly reviewed false detections.
